explanation: The evidence covers only indication and mechanism of action; it contains no data on dosing (125 mg, 21/7 schedule), food instructions, swallowing whole, or missed-dose handling. None of these administration claims are supported by the cited evidence.
suggested_rewrite: Cite the Dosage and Administration section (2.1/2.2) of the IBRANCE label as evidence for dosing regimen, food instructions, and missed-dose handling before presenting these specifics.
